purpose: Traceable per-field extraction of troop mechanics from public Wiki descriptions; not executable runtime logic

sources.scope: Current VNG Mobile troop page with eight group filters, tier groups, mechanic descriptions
sources.notes: Manual extracted Wiki-described events are a subset of source abilities; absent values remain unknown. Compound probability groups preserve relation wording.

sources.scope: Current effects index sampled for named buffs and morale-affecting status examples; unverified labels kept UNKNOWN.

coverage.note: Source-specific extraction is not asserted exhaustive: partial rows and entries with no explicit Wiki mechanics must retain UNKNOWN. Derived trait tags represent prior analyst normalization, not numerical Wiki fact.

mechanicSchema.probability: 0..1 only when explicit in the Wiki
mechanicSchema.target: DERIVED normalized selector corresponding to sourced language; unknown otherwise
mechanicSchema.trigger: DERIVED trigger category when Wiki explicitly names a basic attack/round; UNKNOWN for ambiguous text
mechanicSchema.negativeMoraleDelta: signed integer points when source explicitly says decrease
mechanicSchema.statusId: DERIVED normalized tag; status semantics must be separately mapped to the Wiki Effects catalogue
mechanicSchema.qualitativeMechanics: Non-numerical tags derived from previous catalog; not verified for timing, probability, exact effects or source formula.

multiHitSequence.note: Percent sequence extracted from Wiki; conditional or independent event semantics not verified
